value: Mordenai asks the seeker to aid the disturbed Netherwing drakes. The opening task pairs the gathering of Rocknail prey with feeding the drakes; the scene treats those objectives as one appeal rather than a string of farming actions.
editorNote: Quest objectives are paraphrased. Rocknail combat and feeding counts are compressed into one narrative beat; repeated kills are not separate events. Source pages are secondary quest-text locators; exact original client/build comparison remains open.
